chunks: "Trimming the mustache from one Jumu'ah to the next is protection from leprosy."

key_terms.أَخْذُ: taking or trimming; here, cutting the mustache

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام say about trimming the mustache between one Jumu'ah and the next?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام teaches a regular practice of personal cleanliness tied to the weekly cycle of Jumu'ah. It presents trimming the mustache between one Jumu'ah and the next as a means of protection from leprosy, highlighting the importance of hygiene and bodily care in the Islamic tradition.
